channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula planeja anunciar novo Desenrola em pronunciamento na TV sobre Dia do Trabalho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva plans to announce a new Desenrola program in a nationwide radio and TV broadcast aimed at reducing population indebtedness, during his Workers' Day address scheduled for the evening of April 30. The initiative seeks to expand credit access and renegotiate debts for vulnerable families.

item.title: Relator vota para suspender mandato de deputados que fizeram motim na Câmara
item.description: The rapporteur of the Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee, Deputy Moses Rodrigues (União Brasil-CE), voted for a two-month suspension of the mandates of three lawmakers who stormed the Mesa Diretora during a riot in the chamber. The measure aims to hold accountable those involved in the institutional disorder incident.

item.title: Oposição aciona TCU e questiona uso de R$ 4,5 milhões em organização de acervo pessoal de Lula
item.description: The opposition's deputy leader in the Chamber, Sanderson (PL-RS), filed a representation with the TCU requesting an investigation into the use of R$ 4.5 million for organizing President Lula's personal archive. The action questions the legality and purpose of the public expenditure involved in the initiative.

item.title: Sóstenes promete reação a “golpe aplicado por Lula e Paes” no RJ
item.description: Federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL-RJ) promised a proportional reaction to what he described as a coup carried out by the Judiciary, President Lula, and former Rio mayor Eduardo Paes, following a decision by Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin. He accused them of disrespecting the presidential succession line and claimed the action was coordinated among the three branches. The statement was made in a social media post on Tuesday, the 28th.

item.title: Ministro da França diz que acordo Mercosul-UE é “muito positivo”
item.description: French trade minister Nicolas Forissier called the Mercosul-EU agreement 'very positive', despite France's opposition due to sector-specific demands. The deal was signed in January 2026 and promulgated by Lula on April 28, 2026, while the EU is reviewing its legality in court for up to two years.

item.title: Áudio: Relator defende indicação de Messias; oposição diz que votará contra
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) is holding a hearing for Jorge Messias, the Attorney General of the Union, nominated by President Lula to the Supreme Federal Court (STF). Rapporteur Senator Weverton (PDT-MA) supports the nomination based on Messias' technical qualifications, while the opposition has declared it will vote against, citing concerns over the politicization of the Court. The committee vote will be followed by a plenary session later the same day, requiring 41 votes for approval.

item.title: Flávio é aconselhado a adotar tom equilibrado em sabatina de Messias
item.description: Allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) are advising him to adopt a respectful and balanced tone during the hearing of Jorge Messias before the Senate Constitution and Justice Committee on Wednesday, the 29th. The guidance aims to avoid confrontations and project an image of institutional responsibility.

item.title: Os comentários ácidos de Tarcísio e Zema sobre Gilmar Mendes na Agrishow
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema and São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas interacted casually at the Agrishow, referencing Zema's video series that criticizes STF ministers, especially Gilmar Mendes. Zema teased Tarcísio about being caricatured and defended free speech, while Tarcísio praised Zema's mineiro accent and suggested a coffee meetup. The exchange included indirect criticism of Gilmar Mendes, who had previously sought to include Zema in the fake news inquiry.

item.title: Por que operador do PCC quis pousar no Palácio dos Bandeirantes em 2022
item.description: João Gabriel de Mello Yamawaki, identified as a financial operator of the PCC, was authorized to land his helicopter at the Palácio dos Bandeirantes in March 2022 during João Doria’s administration to attend a São Paulo vs. Palmeiras match. He was targeted in Operation Contaminatio, which investigates the PCC’s 'political nucleus,' and is accused of illegally moving up to R$ 8 billion through the unauthorized digital bank 4TBANK. The Tarcísio de Freitas government denied any involvement, stating it has not authorized landings in his name since taking office in 2023.

item.title: Motta diz que cumpriu "todos os protocolos" ao deixar voo alvo da PF
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, stated he followed all customs protocols when disembarking from a flight under investigation by the Federal Police for allegedly allowing unmonitored baggage entry from a Caribbean tax haven. He said he will await the PGR's statement and denied wrongdoing. The flight also carried Senator Ciro Nogueira and other lawmakers, and is linked to a businessman under scrutiny in the Bets CPI.

item.title: Suspensão de multas do free flow 'desinflama' debate e tira o assunto da arena eleitoral, diz setor
item.description: The federal government suspended for 200 days the fines applied to drivers who did not pay free flow tolls, a measure seen by the road sector as a way to deflate a debate contaminated by political pressures. The decision reduces tension around the issue, temporarily removing it from the electoral agenda.

item.title: “Vaga no STF não é disputa presidencial”, diz relator de indicação de Messias
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha, rapporteur of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, stated that the Supreme Court vacancy should not be treated as a presidential dispute and that the CCJ hearing will take place this Wednesday at 9 a.m. He expressed confidence in approval with an estimated 45 favorable votes, despite resistance from PL, Novo, and part of PP, and emphasized that the process is being conducted institutionally by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Lula assina decreto que promulga acordo UE-Mercosul
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the EU-Mercosur trade agreement, which enters into force on May 1, 2026. The treaty will eliminate tariffs on 91% of European goods for Mercosur within up to 15 years and 95% of Mercosul goods for the EU within up to 12 years, covering 31 countries and a combined population of 720 million.

item.title: Desoneração da folha: PGR se manifesta a favor da solução de Zanin
item.description: The Attorney General’s Office (PGR) supported Minister Cristiano Zanin’s position in the STF, which upholds the constitutionality of the 2024 injunction requiring compensation for revenue loss in payroll tax exemptions. Zanin maintained that Law 14.784/2023, which extended the exemption without specifying compensations, is unconstitutional, but refrained from assessing the political agreement between the government and Congress or the gradual reoneração law (Law 14.973/2024). The PGR emphasized that Zanin’s vote ensures legal security and observes budgetary sustainability, even if the case may lose its object.

item.title: “Do jeito que está, não vão deixar”, diz PF sobre faixa com “ladrão”
item.description: Federal Police approached a resident of Presidente Prudente (SP) for displaying a banner with the word 'thief' near an event with President Lula, stating it could constitute a crime against honor. The resident claimed the message was generic and made on private property without naming the president, but agents said superiors would not view it as protected speech. The PF confirmed the action was based on suspicion of honor offense, in line with security protocols for authorities.

item.title: Construção civil tem a maior inflação para abril em 16 anos
item.description: Construction sector inflation (INCC-M) reached 1.04% in April, the highest for the month since 2010, driven by petroleum-derived input costs and potential Middle East conflict effects. Cbic warns the trend may worsen in May, threatening government housing programs like Minha Casa, Minha Vida and PAC, despite an extra R$20 billion fund and a target of 3 million homes by 2026.

item.title: STF vai julgar queixa-crime de procuradora contra Bolsonaro por calúnia
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court (STF) recognized its jurisdiction to hear a criminal complaint filed by prosecutor Monique Cheker Mendes against former President Jair Bolsonaro for defamation, after he claimed in 2022 that she 'fabricated evidence' in a 2012 environmental investigation. The ruling relies on a 2025 STF precedent establishing that functional jurisdiction for crimes committed in office persists even after leaving office, reversing prior interpretation. The Court ordered both parties to declare within 10 days whether they are interested in a conciliation hearing.

item.title: Lula troca palanque por pronunciamento no Dia do Trabalho
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will skip in-person Labor Day celebrations and deliver a televised and radio address to announce a package of measures aimed at controlling household debt in Brazil, including debt renegotiation with discounts of up to 90%. The initiative seeks to alleviate financial pressure on citizens amid high inflation and elevated interest rates.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Moraes autorização para manutenção em elevador dentro de casa
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro requested authorization from Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes to allow technicians to perform elevator maintenance at his residence in Brasília. He is currently serving a 27-year and 3-month sentence under temporary humanitarian house arrest. The request was made on Tuesday, April 28.

item.title: Governo analisará votações do Congresso para mapear possíveis alianças para outubro
item.description: The Lula government plans to meticulously analyze congressional votes to identify potential allies for the October elections. The analysis will focus on votes regarding the veto of the Dosimetry Bill and the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, both priority issues for the president. Government ministers and congressional leaders will conduct these readings to map which parties are most open to supporting Lula's re-election bid.

item.title: Senador astronauta ensina a ‘burlar’ voto secreto em decisão do Senado sobre Messias
item.description: Senator Marcos Pontes (PL) posted a video teaching how to bypass the secret vote in the Senate's CCJ, urging senators to abstain to register presence without voting, making 'blank' a visible form of opposition. This comes a day before the hearing of Jorge Messias, Lula's nominee for the STF, who needs 14 votes in the CCJ to advance to the plenary.

item.title: TSE e Meta reforçam prazo para regularização do título de eleitor
item.description: The TSE and Meta launched a joint action on Facebook and Instagram to remind voters to regularize their voter registration by May 6, the day before the registration closes for the 2026 Elections. The notice appears at the top of users' feeds with a direct link to the Electoral Self-Service platform, enabling first-time registration, address transfer, or data updates. The initiative aims to expand the reach of Electoral Justice services.

item.title: Ministro do Trabalho rejeita compensar empresas por fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Labor Minister Luiz Marinho rejected the idea of compensating or exempting companies for ending the 6×1 work schedule, stating the Lula government will not grant such benefits, even if included in PEC 8/25. He argued that business sector claims of negative impacts are exaggerated and contradicted by historical evidence, while affirming the government’s openness to future dialogue with affected sectors after the workweek reduction is approved.

item.title: Nova pesquisa mostra duplo problema para Zema em seu reduto eleitoral
item.description: Romeu Zema’s (Novo) government recorded its lowest approval rating in the historical series, with 52% approval and 41% disapproval — a 12-point drop in favorable perception since December 2024. His chosen successor, Mateus Simões (PSD), remains stalled at 3–5% in voter intent, unable to reach double digits even if Senator Cleitinho Azevedo withdraws. Furthermore, 49% of Minas Gerais voters believe Zema does not deserve to elect a successor, while only 28% support a Bolsonaro-aligned governor, signaling a collapse of his ideological base.

item.title: Para Lula, acordo Mercosul-UE é resposta a unilateralismo de Trump
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that the Mercosul-EU agreement is a response to Donald Trump's unilateralism, reinforcing multilateralism and countering U.S. tariffs. The treaty, effective May 1st, provides for gradual elimination of trade barriers, with differentiated quotas and timelines for each bloc, and includes specific industrial products with zero tariffs from the outset.

item.title: Banco Master, STF e Lula na Europa: o que repercutiu nas bolhas online de direita e esquerda
item.description: Last week saw intense online debates over the Banco Master scandal, STF decisions, Lula’s European tour, and Brazil’s high tax burden. Right-wing actors dominated discussions on the scandal and the Court, attempting to link justices to corruption and accuse the STF of electoral interference — particularly regarding the request involving Romeu Zema. The tax burden topic generated nearly 2,000 posts, with Sergio Moro invoking the 1789 Minas Conspiracy to criticize Lula’s fiscal policy.

item.title: Lula promulga acordo Mercosul-UE e diz que texto é reação dos blocos a Trump
item.description: President Lula has promulgated the Mercosul-European Union agreement, describing it as a coordinated response by the blocs to the unilateral policies of the U.S. government under Donald Trump. He emphasized that the deal strengthens trade and political cooperation between the regions, reduces external dependencies, and expands opportunities for Brazilian exports, particularly in agribusiness and industry.

item.title: Haddad diz que tem orgulho de ter taxado os super-ricos
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the pre-candidate for governor of São Paulo from the Workers' Party (PT), said he is proud to have been the finance minister who taxed the super-rich. He emphasized that previously, only workers paid income tax, while billionaires, betting companies, and banks were exempt or paid little. Haddad believes most Brazilians support fiscal justice, where the top of the pyramid pays its fair share.

item.title: Lula assina Acordo Mercosul-UE
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed the promulgation of the Mercosul-European Union Agreement, which will take effect in Brazil on May 1, 2026. He described the deal, reached after 26 years of negotiations, as a response to U.S. unilateralism and a reinforcement of multilateralism, featuring gradual tariff eliminations and quotas for sensitive goods like beef and ethanol. Lula also signed free trade agreements with Singapore and the EFTA bloc.

item.title: Senado aprova cadastro de condenados por violência contra mulher
item.description: The Senate approved a bill to create the National Registry of Persons Convicted of Violence Against Women (CNVM), containing data on individuals definitively convicted of femicide, rape, harassment, bodily injury, stalking, and psychological violence. The bill now awaits presidential sanction and will be managed by the federal government, with information shared among federal, state, and District Federal public security agencies. The initiative aims to deter potential offenders and provide victims with greater sense of security.

item.title: STF: entre a confiança pessoal e a independência institucional
item.description: The nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF) by President Lula reignites the debate over judicial independence, given his past as chief attorney of the AGU and his role in the 2016 wiretap revealing a strategy to nominate Lula as minister to shield him from Operation Car Wash. Though not legally condemned, the episode carries symbolic stigma that raises doubts about his ability to impartially judge the same politicians who benefited him. The choice reflects a trend of STF politicization, where proximity to the Executive is seen as a key asset, threatening the perception of the Court as an independent arbiter in a time of high polarization.

item.title: Saiba onde serão os atos do 1º de Maio pelo Brasil
item.description: Trade union centrals are calling for decentralized acts on Workers' Day, May 1st, 2026, with a central focus on the struggle to reduce the workday (ending the 6X1 shift) without salary reduction, alongside agendas such as combating femicide, confronting precarization, strengthening collective bargaining, and regulating app-based work. Events will take place in multiple Brazilian cities, with specific times and locations disclosed for each locality.

item.title: PF devolve credencial a agente dos EUA após aplicar o princípio da reciprocidade
item.description: The Federal Police returned the work credentials of a U.S. government employee based in Brasília after withdrawing them last week under the principle of reciprocity, in response to the Trump administration’s order for the departure of Brazilian delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho, who was involved in the operation that led to the detention of Alexandre Ramagem. A second U.S. agent, Michael Myers, had already left Brazil on Wednesday under the same measure. The PF stated the return of credentials is pending clarification from the U.S. government regarding its actions against the Brazilian agent.

item.title: Lula diz que Acordo Mercosul-UE foi feito “a ferro, suor e sangue”
item.description: President Lula promulgated the Mercosul-EU Agreement, which takes effect on May 1, 2026 after 26 years of negotiations, describing it as achieved 'by iron, sweat and blood'. The deal will gradually eliminate tariffs on 91% of EU goods by Mercosul and 95% of Mercosul goods by the EU, with quotas for sensitive products such as beef and ethanol, and includes provisions for SMEs and customs facilitation.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Entrevista com Sergio Moro e a nova pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: In the Papo Antagonista program, Senator Sergio Moro, pré-candidate for governor of Paraná, was interviewed about his positions and campaign. The discussion also covered the new AtlasIntel poll, which shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in a hypothetical second round of the 2026 presidential election. The content underscores the relevance of these figures in Brazil’s current political landscape.

item.title: Tarcísio anuncia R$ 455 mi para o agro paulista
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced a R$ 455 million package for São Paulo's agribusiness at Agrishow 2026, allocating R$ 400 million to rural credit, insurance subsidies, and land regularization, and R$ 55 million to machinery and equipment delivery. The Feap Mulher line will receive R$ 25 million to support female farmers, and R$ 100 million will subsidize rural insurance, covering up to R$ 18 billion in agricultural production value. Since 2023, the state has invested R$ 240 million in farm mechanization.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia lamenta agressividade no debate político: “Horrores”
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia lamented the deterioration of political dialogue and the rise of personal attacks among lawmakers during the election year, stating that language—meant for debate and persuasion—has been weaponized as aggression.

item.title: Com receio de atos vazios no 1º de Maio, Lula aposta em pronunciamento com medidas contra endividamento
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is expected to avoid attending May Day events to prevent the risk of low-turnout acts that could have negative political repercussions in an election year. Instead, he will deliver a televised and radio address announcing a package of measures to combat household debt, including debt renegotiation with interest capped at 1.99% per month and discounts of up to 90%.

item.title: Crusoé: O manual do eleitor sem dono
item.description: The Brazilian voter without party affiliation or fixed ideology is portrayed as pragmatic, floating, and dissatisfied, casting votes based on concrete issues like gas prices and security, rather than partisan loyalties or idealized political figures.

item.title: Governo deve aportar de R$ 8 bi a R$ 9 bi em fundo para garantia de 'novo Desenrola' e liberar até R$ 7 bi do FGTS
item.description: The Lula government plans to contribute between R$8 billion and R$9 billion to the Credit Guarantee Fund (FGO) to back a new debt renegotiation program similar to 'Desenrola'. It also aims to release between R$4 billion and R$7 billion from the FGTS to allow eligible individuals to pay off bank debts.

item.title: Relator no Conselho de Ética vota para suspender por dois meses mandato de deputados que ocuparam Mesa Diretora
item.description: Moses Rodrigues (União Brasil-CE), the rapporteur in the Chamber's Ethics Council, voted to suspend the mandates of deputies Zé Trovão (PL-SC), Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) and Marcel Van Hattem (Novo-RS) for two months over their role in blocking the Mesa Diretora during an August 6, 2025 protest. The sanction aims to make clear that Parliament will not tolerate actions disrupting legislative functions. A final vote on the report is scheduled for May 5.

item.title: Moraes diz que políticos usam STF como 'escada eleitoral', e Dino defende atuação contra críticas
item.description: Supreme Court Justices Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino stated that politicians are using the STF as an 'electoral stepping stone' by attacking the court to gain votes. They defended the court's independence during Tuesday's hearing, arguing that political criticism of the STF is driven by electoral interests rather than legitimate concerns about justice.

item.title: TSE retoma julgamento que pode cassar governador de RR e deixar ex-mandatário Denarium inelegível
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is resuming judgment that could remove Roraima Governor Edilson Damião (União) from office and declare former Governor Antonio Denarium (Republicanos) ineligible for eight years over alleged abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 campaign. The current vote stands at 2-1 in favor of removing Damião and 3-0 for Denarium’s ineligibility, with three ministers yet to vote. If Damião is removed, Assembly Speaker Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos) would serve as interim governor, followed by an indirect election by state deputies to fill the remainder of the term.

item.title: Acordo entre Mercosul e União Europeia é oficializado e passa a valer em 1º de maio
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the trade agreement between Mercosul and the European Union, completing Brazil’s internal ratification process. The agreement will provisionally take effect on May 1, following 27 years of negotiations, and covers around 720 million people and economies totaling over US$20 trillion. Lula framed the deal as an assertion of sovereignty and multilateralism, emphasizing that Brazil is no longer a 'banana republic' and that the agreement was forged 'with iron, sweat and blood'.

item.title: STF torna deputado Gustavo Gayer réu por postagem associando Lula ao nazismo e ao Hamas
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court unanimously made federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) a defendant, accepting the PGR's indictment over a social media post associating Lula with Nazism and Hamas via a manipulated image. The court ruled the publication exceeded the limits of free speech and political criticism, constituting an attack on the president's honor, and that parliamentary immunity does not apply as the act occurred outside Congress.

item.title: Caiado: Se chegar à Presidência, vou parar essa reforma tributária na hora
item.description: Former Governor of Goiás Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for President, stated that if elected, he would immediately halt the ongoing tax reform, despite its transitional phase set to conclude in 2033. He opposed the proposed changes, advocating for a pause in implementation.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja até quando fazer e regularizar título de eleitor
item.description: The deadline to issue or update the voter ID for the 2026 elections is Tuesday, May 6. After this date, the electoral registry will close, and no further regularization, address changes, data updates, or first-time issuance will be possible. The process can be completed online via the TSE's Electronic Self-Service or in person at electoral offices and service centers.

item.title: “Não coloquei nome”, diz homem abordado pela PF por faixa com “ladrão”
item.description: A resident of Presidente Prudente (SP) was approached by the Federal Police after displaying a banner reading 'thief' on his apartment window near an event expected to feature President Lula. The PF stated the act could constitute a crime against honor, though the resident claimed it was generic opinion and made on private property without naming anyone. Lula did not attend the event due to recovery from skin cancer surgery.

item.title: Lula assina decreto que promulga acordo Mercosul–UE e conclui ratificação brasileira do tratado após 27 anos de negociações
item.description: President Lula signed the decree promulgating the Mercosul–EU trade agreement, completing Brazil’s ratification after 27 years of negotiations. The treaty establishes one of the world’s largest free-trade zones, with potential to boost Brazil’s GDP by 0.34% by 2044 and increase exports by 2.65%. Safeguard measures were included to protect industry and agribusiness from sudden import surges.

item.title: Os recados de Motta com a composição da comissão especial da PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta appointed Alencar Santana (PT) to chair the special committee analyzing the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale and Leo Prates (Republicanos) as rapporteur, signaling a balance between the government and the productive sector. The move shows support for the Lula administration by giving the PT control of the committee, while Prates’ appointment aims to satisfy market and business demands for a moderate opinion. The committee is expected to be installed this Wednesday, with a vote in the plenary still possible in May.
